title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-94-24一模

items.zh: 我听说你的表弟是个不折不扣的“社牛”,是吗?
items.en: I’ve heard that your cousin is a real social butterfly, isn’t he?

items.zh: 长颈鹿皮肤上橙棕色的斑点使它们可以在野外隐藏自己。
items.en: The orange-brown spots on the giraffes make it possible for them to hide themselves in the wild.

items.zh: 和普通巴士不同,这款智能巴士可以自动规划路线,避让行人和车辆,将乘客送达目的地。
items.en: Unlike regular buses, the smart bus can plan routes automatically, avoid pedestrians and vehicles, and deliver passengers to their destinations.

items.zh: 今年参展的不少中国品牌产品通过对东方文化的深度挖掘，将传统与时尚融合，赢得了年轻族的青睐。
items.en: Digging deep into Eastern culture, many Chinese brands taking part in this year’s exhibition have integrated tradition with fashion, thus winning the favor of the young generation.
